body:
Part of **New page: Strategy** (72986e081ef982d9). Every page piece is Gleam compiled to JavaScript; server pieces are Rust (`tasks.rs`, `board.rs`). Nothing compiles to BEAM.

This needs design and a decision before work starts. Points to settle:

- **Where the run lives.** Every run today belongs to a task, and agents can't write strategy records.
- **Proposed shape.** A root-level, read-only "strategy" run, discuss-like, started from the page. It can read every project, to understand the product. New agent commands (`strategy feature|milestone|task|vision`) send proposals through the inbox (`drain`/`apply` in `tasks.rs`), and a human accepts or rejects them on the page.
- **Rust work.** Launching runs (`board.rs`), message kinds (`tasks.rs`), commands and `reference.txt` (`main.rs`).

**Scope:** `solace-cli/strategy` is not in the root `solace.toml` yet. A human adds it, then it is added to this task's scope.
title: Strategy: agent collaboration (design first)
